visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal carousel of white article cards (landscape image, linked title with arrow, category pill links); prev/next arrows and a progress bar
visualCharacteristics.description: Sand/beige background rgb(212,204,196), 64px vertical padding. Header row: H3 left, "Read our blog" arrow link right. Carousel of 6 white article cards: landscape image, H3 title + arrow icon, small outlined category pill link; prev/next arrows and green progress bar.

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide. Cell 1: article image. Cell 2: H3 title linked to the article, then a paragraph with one or more category links (rendered as outlined pills)
contentPattern.description: Carousel of 6 blog article cards (image, title linking to article, category tag link) | White article cards (landscape image, title with arrow, category pill link) on a sand band; differs from product/video carousels in card chrome and content

usage: Use for latest blog/article rails; set section style beige for the sand band.
reuseGuidance: For video cards use carousel-video; for product hotspots use carousel-hotspot.
